effective_invocation_policy.declaration_semantics: invocation.json is a machine-readable SELF-DECLARATION of the planned EFFECTIVE invocation (values after applying CLI overrides, not raw argv). A passing preflight means only that the declared planned invocation is compatible with this gate; it is NOT proof that the actual later run was started with exactly these arguments. The after-the-fact proof is the post-run manifest verification (see pilot_preflight.post_run_manifest_verification).
effective_invocation_policy.rationale: The evaluation_condition hash freezes the config/default state, but run_correctness.py accepts runtime-effective CLI overrides. A pilot run may therefore execute under a different EFFECTIVE condition while the repo-state checker still reports fresh. pilot_002 must use the frozen evaluation condition: verdict-relevant overrides are either not passed at all, or their effective values must be materialized and checked against this gate BEFORE the run (no silent mixture).

enhanced.historical_source: the spec objects stored INSIDE the pilot_001 enhanced result records (thesis/results/intermediate/pilot_001/<model>/enhanced_tests.jsonl). No hypothetical reconstruction of the old suite with today's mutator was used as historical truth.

extreme_values.note: `pattern` is part of spec_key, so a historical extreme_values spec can never match a current alternating spec. The E2-B finding that both now realize the same bytes does NOT make the historical results reusable: that run executed the OLD extreme semantics.

e3_reexecution_set.note: The 10 authoritative E3 retained-drifted specs (same spec_key, changed input semantics) touch 9 benchmarks, NONE of which is in the pilot_001 population, so they contribute nothing to this comparison. They remain non-comparable by construction wherever they do apply.

input_drift_determination.classifier: thesis/enhanced_tests/classify_specs_e2b.drift_reason (the productive, test-frozen classifier; E2-A DType map + E2-B spike/extreme semantics)
input_drift_determination.why_zero: no pilot benchmark appears in the E2-A DType drift map (that map covers reduce/28, scan/31, sort/42, sort/43) and no SAME_KEY spec uses spike_at (all 3 current spike_at specs are current-only).
input_drift_determination.residual_dependency: For the 9 pilot benchmarks that DO have a fill site, 'same input' additionally rests on the E2-A.1 measurement that the rewritten enhanced-fill.hpp is value-identical to the old header for every range the validator admits. That was not re-measured here. It is not load-bearing: all 123 of those SAME_KEY specs are already excluded from direct comparability on verdict-mechanism grounds.

enhanced.mutation_frontier_caveat: The pilot_001 productive suite was NOT the seed rows alone: build_benchmark_specs combined static base + LLM seeds + mutations, and the historical frontier was additionally shaped by duplicate and invalid seed rows (E3.1). The current frontier is built from unique valid artifact seed identities. That is exactly why the historical side of this comparison is taken from the RESULT RECORDS and never reconstructed by re-running today's mutator over the old seed file.
enhanced.direct_same_input_comparable_rationale: Only graph/15 and reduce/25 qualify. Both have ZERO ENHANCED_FILL sites (pattern_effect NONE in the capability catalog), so neither the E2-A.1 fill rewrite nor any E2-B pattern policy can touch their input - it varies through `size` alone, and rand() is deliberately unseeded (utilities.hpp:251) so inputs are byte-reproducible. Their cpu.cc and baseline.hpp are byte-unchanged since pilot_001 and their graded payloads are discrete scalars, so the K2/K4 additions in reportAndCompareScalarImpl are compile-time dead.

historical_provenance_limitation.detail: pilot_001 enhanced_tests_summary.json carries no policy hash, no specs hash and no execution fingerprint (enhanced_execution_provenance / enhanced_model_execution_provenance / enhanced_policy_provenance are all absent). It records effective_config and the specs_file PATH only. The harness state is pinned only indirectly, through the run manifest's git_commit, which was written by the GENERATION stage on 2026-08-12 while the enhanced stage ran on 2026-08-20.
historical_provenance_limitation.not_retroactively_attributed: The E3.1.1 enhanced_execution_fingerprint / model_execution_fingerprint describe the CURRENT condition only. pilot_001 is not credited with that provenance.
